product_one_liner.value: Together AI provides a full-stack AI cloud for developers and enterprises to run inference, fine-tune models, and use GPU compute to build and deploy AI applications.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage and documentation describe the platform and audience.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies San Francisco, California as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: Blog index features multiple substantive technical posts on inference optimization, GPU kernels, agentic inference, and systems engineering.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes API and model guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The active listing is a Forward Deployed Engineer, Post-Training role.

model_provider.value: Together AI publicly offers models from providers including OpenAI, Moonshot, DeepSeek, Z.ai, MiniMax, Qwen, Cartesia, and NVIDIA through its platform; it does not publicly identify one exclusive underlying provider.
model_provider.notes: The product is a multi-model platform rather than a single-provider model service.
